query: select d.id as datacenter, count(t.id) as open, sum(t.severity in ('high', 'critical')) as urgent from Datacenter d left join Host h on h.datacenter = d.id left join Application a on a.runsOn = h.id left join Ticket t on t.application = a.id and t.status <> 'resolved' group by d.id order by d.id
